webinars.title: The Economics of Modern Storage Infrastructure: Lower Risk, Faster AI Value, Better ROI
webinars.whyUse: Use this for enterprise, midmarket conversations around data platform architectures & economics.
webinars.abstract:
To succeed with AI and wider digital transformation efforts, businesses need an advanced data infrastructure to cope with the high demands of modern technology. That means silos, legacy IT, and slow processing speeds have to be replaced by systems that drive faster decision making and deliver game changing insight among other things. And all this needs to be delivered with security at the front and centre.

So, what steps must IT leaders take? In this CIO webcast, with Hitachi Vantara and Brocade, we will explore how to build an integrated, resilient, autonomous and future ready data infrastructure.

Key learning points:

- Predictable performance and Tier-0 resilience to reduce risk and protect ROI
- Cut cost and complexity by eliminating silos and avoiding the “migration tax”
- Plan for quantum-safe security and energy-efficient scaling across environments

webinars.title: Is Object Storage the New AI Foundation?
webinars.useCase: Data Readiness and Activation for AI
webinars.whyUse: Use this for enterprise conversations around data readiness and activation for ai.
webinars.abstract:
AI has moved to production—but data readiness lags behind. AI isn’t compute-bound—it’s data-bound. Transforming fragmented and siloed data into governed, reusable, AI-ready assets is essential.

Join Hitachi Vantara and GigaOm as we explore how modern object storage is becoming the AI foundation. Learn what’s changed, why it matters now, and how leading organizations are rethinking object storage as the backbone of AI. In this session, you will:
• Understand why AI is reshaping storage requirements—and why object storage is now the primary data plane for AI, analytics, and unstructured data.
• Learn what makes object storage truly “AI‑ready,” including scale‑out architectures for linear growth, built-in security, efficient small object handling and metadata management.
• Hear an independent analyst's perspective on where the object storage market is heading and what to expect over the next 12–18 months.

webinars.title: Resilient by Design: How Hitachi Vantara, VM2020, and Index Engines Deliver Faster, Validated Ransomware Recovery
webinars.owner: Macey Jones, Stephanie Thompson, Sulochna Khokhrai
webinars.whyUse: Use this for enterprise, midmarket conversations around cyber risk mitigation & recovery.
webinars.abstract:
When an attack hits, your ability to recover quickly and confidently depends on the resilience of your data, the intelligence of your detection, and the speed of your recovery infrastructure.

In this 45-minute session, Hitachi Vantara, VM2020, and Index Engines will show how their solutions — Virtual Storage Platform One, CyberVR, and CyberSense — work individually and together to give organizations a clear path from attack to a faster, validated recovery.

What You’ll Walk Away With:
• Guidance on building ransomware resilience, starting from wherever you are today
• A practical approach for ongoing resilience management — including how to use continuous validation, audit-ready reporting, and policy enforcement to stay compliant and recovery-ready, not just when an attack hits, but every day
• A clear understanding of the gap between “we have backups” and “we can actually recover” — and how to close it
• Live demo: a simulated ransomware recovery scenario walked end-to-end across the joint solution
• A forensics-first mindset: how to know what was hit, what’s clean, and what’s safe to restore
• A look at how automated recovery orchestration delivers repeatable workflows that shrink recovery time from days to hours

webinars.title: Omdia: What Modern Data Infrastructure Looks Like in the AI Era
webinars.whyUse: Use this for enterprise, midmarket conversations around data platform architectures & economics.
webinars.abstract:
As AI moves from pilot to production, infrastructure gaps become harder to ignore. Performance bottlenecks slow data delivery. Fragmented environments complicate governance. Poor workload placement increases cost, risk, and operational complexity.

The question is no longer whether to modernize. It is where to start without creating another disruptive transformation project.

Join Simon Robinson, Chief Analyst - Omdia, and Andy Gremett, Senior Product Marketing Manager - Hitachi Vantara, for a practical discussion based on recent data-modernization research. You will learn how to identify your most urgent infrastructure constraint, make more intentional workload-placement decisions, and build a modernization plan that delivers measurable value in manageable steps.

In this webinar, you'll learn how to:
• Prepare data infrastructure for production AI
• Place workloads where they perform best
• Balance cost, control, and resilience
• Identify the right place to start modernization
• Apply a practical five-step modernization framework

webinars.title: CIO with Joe Morris- The CIO Balancing Act: Business Continuity and AI Ambition
EDUCAUSE Webinar: Resilience in the AI Era
webinars.useCase: Data Readiness and Activation for AI
webinars.whyUse: Use this for enterprise conversations around data readiness and activation for ai.
webinars.abstract: Every campus has a breach story. The only question is whether yours has been written yet. In this candid talk on cyber resilience, we discuss the true fallout from a cyberattack — and why one is inevitable. AI has turned vulnerability discovery into an arms race between developers and hackers, greatly increasing the cost of digital debt from unpatched systems.   At the same time, data exfiltration and traditional backup approaches leave institutions at risk, even when their data is fully recoverable. Join us to learn about the methods of protection available and the gaps that still remain in your planning.   Learning Outcomes:   Explain why breaches are inevitable and how AI accelerates both exploit discovery and patch cycles   Identify the modern complexities of cyber resilience, including exfiltration, the gaps in traditional disaster recovery, cyber insurance pitfalls, and regulatory concerns   Build a data-driven case for the funding needed to improve your overall resilience
